purpose: This table provides one cleaned row per airport runway, sourced from the OurAirports runways extract, intended to support analytics on runway surface, dimensions, lighting/closure status, and the geographic endpoints (low-end and high-end) of each runway.
usage: Join on runway_id for a unique runway record, or on airport_ref/airport_ident to associate runways with airports; consumers should expect nulls in the latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold fields (roughly 22% to 90% null depending on the column) and must handle them explicitly rather than assume completeness.
limitations: Geographic and dimensional fields for runway ends (le_* and he_*) are missing in 22% to 90% of rows per the profiled null rates, and were retained as nulls rather than imputed; airport_ident and surface remain free text because their sample values are not uniformly structured, so no further normalization (e.g., surface code standardization) was applied in this pass.
